gaps: No fish or seafood of any kind across all 13 mains.
Chinese cuisine is absent — the one Asian dish is a generic noodle.
North Indian cooking is missing; the only Indian dish is South Indian.
The Big Green Egg and grill are never used for a weekend project main.
Italian pasta stays at one technique (aglio e olio); no umami-built or caramelized sauce.

ideas.title: Crispy Pan Fried Fish
ideas.why: Seafood is completely absent from the rotation; this cast-iron technique fills the protein gap fast on a weeknight.

ideas.title: Japchae (Sweet Potato Starch Noodles Stir Fried with Vegetables)
ideas.why: Korean cuisine is completely missing; this wok-friendly glass-noodle dish is instantly kid-approved and trivially made vegetarian.

ideas.title: Vegan Mapo Tofu
ideas.why: Chinese cuisine is absent and tofu as a protein never appears; shiitake mushrooms replace pork without sacrificing umami.

ideas.title: Palak Paneer
ideas.why: North Indian cooking is missing entirely; paneer introduces a new vegetarian protein and a totally different spice vocabulary from the one South Indian dish already in rotation.

ideas.title: BBQ Char Siu (Chinese Roast Pork) on the Grill
ideas.why: The Big Green Egg is never used for a project main; overnight-marinated pork shoulder over live fire fills the weekend-project and Chinese-cuisine gaps at once.

ideas.title: Caramelized Shallot Pasta
ideas.why: Italian pasta stays at a single technique; this anchovy-and-tomato-paste jammy sauce teaches a completely different flavor-building approach and is vegetarian with one ingredient omitted.
